result:
I implemented `Array.prototype.sort` in `crates/kahvi-builtins/src/array/prototype_sort.rs`, and it builds, is clippy-clean and is formatted. Not every sort test passes yet: the 18 failures across the run are all "not implemented" errors from other built-ins (ArrayBuffer 8, Array.prototype.pop 4, String.prototype.slice 4, RegExp 2), so none come from sort itself.

I added `SortIndexedProperties` (as `sort_indexed_properties`, `pub(crate)`) and `CompareArrayElements` as private helpers in this file, because no shared versions exist and `toSorted` and the TypedArray sorts will need the same code. The sort is a stable merge sort that propagates comparator errors. I did not run my own behavioural check because that command was denied.
